functions.name: vault_directory
functions.title: Read Vault Account Directory
functions.description: Read the signed-in admin's saved account references, never credentials or access keys. Supports pages of 50 records; pass the returned next_offset to read another page. Connection type indicates a slot or reference, not verified live status.

offset.description: Starting offset from 0 to 10000; defaults to 0.

functions.name: submit_lead
functions.title: Submit Lead
functions.description: Submit a new lead or newsletter signup to Strategic Minds AI. Use when someone wants to contact the agency or join the newsletter. Creates a CRM contact for contact-form submissions and schedules a follow-up. Returns ok on success.

form_type.description: newsletter for newsletter signups, contact for contact form submissions

message.description: Message body. Required for contact form (min 6 chars), optional for newsletter. Max 5000 chars.

functions.name: request_quote
functions.title: Request Quote
functions.description: Request a custom quote for a catalog item priced as 'quote'. Use when a prospect wants a tailored proposal for an enterprise or custom service. Returns ok on success.

itemId.description: The catalog item ID to request a quote for

functions.name: discover_capabilities
functions.title: Discover Connected Capabilities
functions.description: Run a read-only discovery probe across all connected integrations (Google, GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, Railway, Stripe, AI Gateway). Admin only. Returns which services are connected and verified for read access. Use when checking the health of the agency's integrations.
